FEATURE GUIDE

Read DaouOffice leave and events

See your company leave status and this month’s calendar events in HappyLulu.

Mac 1.5.15 build31

OverviewHow to useExampleSupport and limitsRelated features

Overview

The DaouOffice plugin reads remaining, used and total annual leave, past and upcoming leave for this year, and this month’s events from your calendars. Select it as a feature source to display the information in the panel and calendar. Its developer is 손정열 (Son Jeong-yeol).

This is a read-only company connection. It does not submit leave requests or create, edit or delete remote events. The separate two-way calendar sync has its own setup.

How to use

  1. Install and enable DaouOffice in Settings → Plugin management.
  2. Open its settings and enable Connect DaouOffice. Enter your company’s base HTTPS address, ID and password, then choose Save and fetch.
  3. If a CAPTCHA appears, read the image and enter the characters yourself, then confirm to continue. You can request a new image or cancel.
  4. Choose DaouOffice separately as the source for events, leave status or half-day recognition.

When saving the same company address and ID again, leave the password field blank to reuse the password stored in Keychain. Changing the address or ID requires that account’s password.

Example

Display company events in the calendar and check remaining leave in the menu panel. If recognition is enabled, explicit “Morning half day” or “Afternoon half day” event titles can supply the half-day mode. Annual leave balances never imply a half day.

Saving starts the first fetch. The app refreshes every 15 minutes while running and shows the last successful and next planned fetch times. A failed fetch retains the last successful data, so check its refresh status too.

Support and limits

This optional feature is available in Mac 1.5.15 build31, not Windows 1.5.13. Calendar events cover the current month only. An unavailable month does not mean it has no events. Holidays are shown only for actual dates overlapping the requested month.

Company configuration and DaouOffice versions can affect support. SSO-only accounts, company selection, second-factor authentication and password changes are not automated. Automatic refresh pauses while waiting for a human to enter a CAPTCHA.

Passwords stay in macOS Keychain; fetched leave and events stay in memory. Disconnecting cancels requests and clears in-memory results, while retaining saved connection details for reconnection. Fetching does not create historical attendance.
